Exclusion (condition D) is resolved before validation and freshness. Excluded components are pinned at SAFE (least element of the severity order); they contribute the least to max-severity and never raise the classification.

Resolution failure (invalid, absent, stale on a required non-excluded component) resolves to bottom; g_i(bottom) = UNSAFE by definition; UNSAFE is the maximal element of the severity order so global S = UNSAFE via max-severity. Fail-safe is a corollary of C.1b, not a separate pre-check.
g_w : R>=0 union {bottom} -> S. SAFE w<=21.6; CAUTION 21.6<w<=27.0; UNSAFE w>27.0. Boundaries anchored to MET Malaysia Category 1 (40 km/h = 21.598 kn) and Category 2 (50 km/h = 26.998 kn).

g_r : R>=0 x K -> S. Two inputs (rate, kappa). Storm route: kappa = 1 gives UNSAFE for every r. Rate route (kappa = 0): SAFE r<=10.0; CAUTION 10.0<r<=20.0; UNSAFE r>20.0. kappa = chi(c); chi(c) = 1 iff c in {95, 96, 99}; chi is total into K and never returns bottom.
